usageNotes: Use this to list all metric server integrations configured on the cluster (e.g. InfluxDB, Graphite). Requires `Sys.Audit` on the root path — API tokens are supported. The `disable` flag on each entry indicates whether the plugin is currently active; a server appearing in the list does not guarantee it is receiving metrics.

examples.summary: List all configured metric servers on the cluster

tips: Check the `disable` field on each result — a configured server with `disable: true` is not receiving any metrics.
Use `type` to distinguish InfluxDB vs. Graphite entries when multiple backends are configured.
Pair with the individual get/update endpoints (e.g. get_cluster_metrics_server_id) to inspect or modify a specific entry by its `id`.
